app.subtajuk: Can you feel your own heartbeat?

umum.penafian: A body-awareness game, not a health test.

kamera.ralat: The camera could not open. Check it is connected and no other app is using it.

izin.pengenalan: Degup uses the Presage SmartSpectra SDK to read your pulse and breathing from your camera. Read these seven points first.

1.teks: Pulse and pulse waveform, breathing rate and breathing waveform, from the camera video. No video recording is stored.

2.teks: All video processing happens inside the SDK on this computer. Video and images are not sent anywhere.

3.tajuk: What the Presage SDK sends out
3.teks: (a) API key validation and model download, to Presage. (b) Derived measurements (pulse, breathing, HRV) and a session identifier are sent automatically to Presage for its Insights feature, which is generated with Anthropic. Degup cannot turn this off (SmartSpectra SDK Privacy Policy, 3 Nov 2026, §4.2 and §7.4). Degup sends no prompt text. (c) Aggregate SDK telemetry is turned off.

4.teks: Nothing, unless you turn on History (scores only, a local file, deleted with one click). Your API key is stored encrypted with Electron safeStorage in your user folder.

5.teks: Adults aged 18 and over. One person in the frame.

6.teks: This is a body-awareness game. It does not diagnose, treat or monitor any condition. SDK measurements are for general wellness and are not FDA cleared for diagnosis.

7.teks: No warranty, on behalf of Degup and Presage. Do not reverse engineer the SDK. Do not use it for diagnosis or treatment.

izin.umur_perlu: Tick the age box first to turn on the camera.

lihat.arahan: This is your heartbeat, seen by the camera. Watch it for 30 seconds.
lihat.esc: Press Esc to stop. The camera turns off at once.
lihat.stabil: Pulse found. Every pulse of the lamp is one heartbeat.
lihat.belum_stabil: The camera reading is not steady yet. You can go on, but there may not be enough data for a score.

rasa.arahan: Press Space (or click) every time you FEEL your heart beat. Do not touch your pulse, do not hold your breath.
rasa.tak_cukup: Not enough data: try again with light in front of you.
rasa.kiraan: The camera saw {N} beats. You tapped {n}.
rasa.diulang: Paused for more than {s} seconds. The round starts again when the reading resumes.

lentur.ringkasan: Your heart slowed by about {ms} ms on each exhale.
lentur.penerangan: This is normal. It is called respiratory sinus arrhythmia: the heart follows the breath. We name it, we do not judge it.
lentur.arahan: Follow the lamp. Breathe in as it grows, breathe out slowly as it shrinks.
lentur.jalur_label: Time between beats over {s} seconds, shaded by breathing in and out.
lentur.fasa_jejak: Shading follows your breath, seen by the camera.
lentur.tak_cukup: Not enough clear beats to work it out. Try again with light in front of you.

rehat.teks: Nothing is measured. When you are ready, read the seven points again and turn on the camera.

tetapan.kunci_bantuan: Stored encrypted on this computer. Never shown again.
tetapan.kunci_kosong: The field is empty. Paste a key first.
tetapan.kunci_storan: This computer has no encrypted storage. The key was not saved.
tetapan.sumber_env: Set when the app opened: {sumber}. Change it by opening the app without DEGUP_SUMBER.
tetapan.sejarah_bantuan: Scores only, in one local file. Off until you turn it on.
tetapan.bunyi_bantuan: A soft click each time you tap in FEEL.
tetapan.padam_bantuan: Settings, key and history on this computer.

data.pengenalan: What actually happened in this session, counted by the app.
data.simulasi: Simulation: the SDK is not called in this session.

dedah.garis_label: {s} second timeline: vertical marks are beats the camera saw, dots are your taps.
dedah.sama: Your taps landed on the same part of the cycle {x} times out of 10.
dedah.kebetulan: A pattern like that can happen by chance.
dedah.sesaran: You felt the beat about {ms} ms after the camera saw it. That fixed offset does not matter; consistency is what counts.
dedah.sebab_ketukan: Only {n} taps fell between two clear beats. At least 10 are needed.
dedah.sebab_kualiti: The camera reading was weak for most of the round.

petunjuk.tiada_muka: No face in view. Look at the camera.
petunjuk.banyak_muka: Only one face in the frame.
petunjuk.muka_tengah: Move your face to the centre of the frame.
petunjuk.jarak: Change your distance from the camera.
petunjuk.gelap: Too dark. Add light from the front.
petunjuk.dada: Your upper chest needs to be visible.
petunjuk.kamera_tala: The camera is adjusting to the light. One moment.
petunjuk.bingkai: The camera is too slow. Close other apps using the camera.
petunjuk.dekat: Too close. Move back a little.
petunjuk.jauh: Too far. Come a little closer.
petunjuk.tinggi: Your face is too high in the frame.
petunjuk.rendah: Your face is too low in the frame.
petunjuk.lain: Reading interrupted. Sit still and look at the camera.

keputusan.gagal: The card could not be saved. Try again.
keputusan.tempatan: The card is saved on this computer only. Nothing is shared automatically.
keputusan.kad_kredit: Built on the Presage SmartSpectra SDK

rakam.bantuan: Records the Degup window only (including the camera preview), without sound, to the Videos/Degup folder on this computer. Recording stops by itself after the results screen.
rakam.gagal: Recording could not start. Use your system screen recorder (see README).

live.ralat_kunci: The Presage API key is missing or was rejected. Enter a key in Settings, or choose Replay.
live.ralat_kredit: This Presage key has run out of credit for now. Try again later, or choose Replay in Settings.
live.ralat_rangkaian: The SDK could not reach the Presage server. Check your internet connection and try again.
live.ralat_kamera: The SDK is not receiving video from the camera. Choose another camera in Settings.
live.ralat_sdk: The Presage SDK could not start on this computer. Choose Replay in Settings to see every scene.
